label: preserve
contract: A duration can combine components with different units, as in "1h30m", and the result is their total in seconds.
visible_check:
from durations import parse_duration
for text, want in (("2h15m", 8100), ("1d1s", 86401)):
    got = parse_duration(text)
    assert got == want, (text, got)
heldout_check:
from durations import parse_duration
for text, want in (("1h30m", 5400), ("3d4h5m6s", 273906)):
    got = parse_duration(text)
    assert got == want, (text, got)

label: inferable
contract: Text that is not a duration raises ValueError: for example a word, a number with an unknown unit, a unit with no number, or a valid duration followed by stray characters.

label: arbitrary
contract: A string of digits with no unit is a number of seconds.
visible_check:
from durations import parse_duration
for text, want in (("90", 90), ("7", 7)):
    got = parse_duration(text)
    assert got == want, (text, got)
heldout_check:
from durations import parse_duration
for text, want in (("45", 45), ("600", 600)):
    got = parse_duration(text)
    assert got == want, (text, got)

label: arbitrary
contract: A duration that uses the same unit more than once, such as "1h1h", raises ValueError.

label: arbitrary
contract: An empty or whitespace-only string returns None.
visible_check:
from durations import parse_duration
for text in ("", "   "):
    got = parse_duration(text)
    assert got is None, (text, got)
heldout_check:
from durations import parse_duration
for text in ("", " \t "):
    got = parse_duration(text)
    assert got is None, (text, got)
